methodology.bsonSmall: 50,000 in-process BSON encodes and 50,000 full decodes of a 334-byte mixed-type todo document; no MongoDB
methodology.bsonString: 1,000 in-process BSON encodes and 1,000 full decodes of a document containing one 256-KiB UTF-8 string; no MongoDB
methodology.bsonArray: 1,000 in-process BSON encodes and 1,000 full decodes of a document containing 4,096 integers; no MongoDB
methodology.concurrent: 4,000 acknowledged ping commands split over 64 workers; pool sizes 1, 4, 16, and 64
methodology.large: 10 sequential acknowledged inserts and indexed reads of 256-KiB documents with 4,096-number arrays
methodology.batch: 2,000 documents inserted in batches of 100, followed by one acknowledged multi-document update
methodology.process: macOS /usr/bin/time -l wall/user/system CPU, peak RSS, peak footprint, and page-reclaim counters
methodology.aggregation: median across rotated driver order; all raw samples retained
